text:
Marta: Quick thread to finalize GA gate for the Keystone rollout. Need owners for SLA validation, pricing smoke, docs/runbook, canary cadence, and dashboards. Can we lock these now?
Evan: I9ll own SLA validation + perf runs. Proposal: hosted p99 <= 230ms, availability 99.95% for GA window. Dedicated gets throughput SLAs and 99.9% availability.
Renee: I can do docs and customer pricing examples. Will need a short billing-smoke script and an example invoice.
Kai: I'll take canary + runtime fallbacks. Suggest warmup + staged ramp: warmup 1h @2%, then 4h @10%, 12h @30%, then 24h @100% if all green. Auto-rollback if p99 >300ms or errors >0.3% for 10m.
Marta: Owners recap: Evan=SLA+tests, Renee=docs+billing, Kai=canary+rollback. Ops: please create tickets and schedule canary. @ops-bot
ops-bot: Created tickets: INF-6120 (Keystone SLA tests), INF-6121 (Keystone canary plan), INF-6122 (Keystone billing-smoke). Links: https://go/infra/INF-6121
Evan: Test plan: 1) Synthetic: 50k sustained QPS for 30m; measure p50/p95/p99, GPU utilization, memory tails. 2) Replay: 6h production mix at 20k QPS. Pass: p99 <=230ms and no sustained error spike (>0.1%) for 15m.
Renee: Billing-smoke checklist:
```
- Run sample requests for short/med/long seqs (8, 128, 1024)
- Verify token pricing and per-request line items
- Confirm invoice fields for model, tokens, and dedicated surcharges
- End-to-end: create test org -> generate 200 requests -> confirm invoice entries
```
Renee: billing quick curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
 -H "Authorization: Bearer test_key" \\
 -d '{"model":"keystone-2026","input":"test","max_tokens":64}'
```
Kai: Observability needs: per-route p95/p99, KV-cache hit-rate, request size histogram, traffic split. Add regression alert wired to the eval harness comparing baseline prompts. Also add token-cost per-request metric for finance.
Evan: Agree re: KV metrics. Also want tracing hooks from runtime so we can attribute latency to kernel/kv/cache. I'll coordinate with infra to run the synthetic and post JSON reports here.
Renee: Docs timeline: rough draft of user-facing howto + billing examples by Thu EOD, final by next Tue after review. I'll ping finance for example invoice.
Marta: GA decision checklist we agreed: 
- SLA validation green (owner: Evan)
- Billing-smoke passed and pricing examples verified (Renee + Finance)
- Canary executed per plan with no rollbacks for 24h at 100% (Kai + SRE)
- Runbook and docs published (Renee)
- Dashboards + regression alerts live (Evan)
If anything fails -> hold GA and run rollback playbook.
Evan: I'll schedule the synthetic runs tomorrow AM and share results.
Kai: Will land fallback PR and canary scripts today. ETA 6pm.
Renee: Starting docs now, will share preview link when ready.
Marta: Thanks all. Put any blocker flags in the tickets. If we see risks, we'll push GA. :thumbsup:
